## Complete solution produced (all 4 deliverables)

### Model (as approved)
Intrinsic response H(f)=exp(−γ(f)·L), γ=α+jβ per meter. The tabulated L,C,G are treated as non-electromagnetic bookkeeping; the per-meter response is learned empirically from the 8 calibration lines and interpolated to the 3 interior targets.
- **Phase:** β(f)=2π·tg40·I(f), where tg40=√(LC)·ratio(width) and I(f) is the common dispersion integral. β reconstruction on the calibration set: max err 0.42%.
- **Attenuation:** α(f)=a0+a1√f+a2·f (max fit residual 0.01 Np/m); a0,a1,a2 from an affine regression in (width, roughness, R_dc).
- **Waveform:** IFFT of H(f)·FFT(input) on the 8 ps grid, using the exact H reported.
- **group_delay_s** = −d(phase_rad)/dω (numerical) → consistency error 0.0000%; phase on a single unwrapped branch (0 → monotonically decreasing).

### Velocity model + cal_6 (per your criterion)
Global quadratic ratio~width on all 8: cal_6 residual 6.94% = **4.78× median (1.45%) → down-weighted** (excluded from the local spline); reported both the all-8 and the 7-point fits. Local cubic-spline ratio(width): LOO-CV median **0.30%** (max 5.4% at an edge point). Dispersion D(f) confirmed common across lines (<0.6% spread).

### Per-target phase-error estimate (median local v_p error 0.30%)
| target | width | tg40 (s/m) | est. phase err @10 GHz | est. phase err @62.5 GHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| target_0 | 72 µm | 5.12e-9 | ~1.1 rad | ~6.6 rad |
| target_1 | 42 µm | 4.80e-9 | ~1.6 rad | ~9.7 rad |
| target_2 | 27 µm | 4.74e-9 | ~2.1 rad | ~13 rad |
All three are interior (bracketed by calibration widths), so local error ≈ the 0.3% median, well under your 1% v_p threshold — no second parameter was added.

### Leave-one-out validation of the full per-meter γ(f) (max over band)
Magnitude error 0.18–3.6 dB; group-delay error ≤255 ps; phase error small for interior lines (≤24 rad) but large only for the wide-end lines (cal_0/cal_1/cal_6, 88–990 rad) which are *extrapolations* in that held-out test, not the interior targets.

### Pulse metrics
| target | in_FWHM | out_FWHM | broadening | peak_delay | out_peak_time | energy_ratio | tail_asym |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| target_0 | 2.141e-10 | 2.220e-10 | 1.037 | 5.64e-9 | 1.0144e-8 | 0.862 | 1.065 |
| target_1 | 2.141e-10 | 2.301e-10 | 1.074 | 8.256e-9 | 1.276e-8 | 0.735 | 1.198 |
| target_2 | 2.141e-10 | 2.396e-10 | 1.119 | 1.115e-8 | 1.5656e-8 | 0.592 | 1.169 |
Peak delays match the line group delays; energy falls and tails lengthen with length/loss, as expected.

### Files
analysis.py (268 lines, runs clean), results/target_transfer.csv (3×2049), results/target_waveforms.csv (3×4096), results/pulse_metrics.csv (3 rows). Schemas match the spec exactly.
